chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, who said:
I heard al-Rida (peace be upon him) say: The Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) is equal to a purified and accepted 'Umrah.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this chain from Imam al-Rida (a.s.) to emphasize that the spiritual merit of visiting Imam al-Husayn’s shrine is equivalent to an accepted 'Umrah, a status that underscores the shrine's centrality in Shia devotional geography. This comparison elevates Ziyarah from a mere visitation to a major act of worship, linking the martyrdom of the Ahl al-Bayt directly to the purification and acceptance associated with the Prophet’s pilgrimage rituals.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, who said:
I heard Imam Riďā (a.s.) say: Going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) is equal to performing a purified and accepted ‘Umrah.
